description: This file defines the IncludeNode class used in Twig templating engine to handle 'include' template tags. It provides methods for compiling the node into executable code and manages template inclusion with optional variables and error handling.

classes.name: Twig\Node\IncludeNode
classes.description: Represents an include node within Twig's abstract syntax tree, responsible for rendering include tags with optional variables and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the IncludeNode with an expression, optional variables, flags for 'only' and 'ignoreMissing', and source line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to render the included template, handling 'ignore missing' errors and passing variables appropriately.

methods.name: addGetTemplate
methods.description: Helper method to generate code for loading a specific template instance.

methods.name: addTemplateArguments
methods.description: Prepares template variables for inclusion, considering 'only' flag and merging context.
